description: This file defines a FastAPI router handling API endpoints related to submissions in a data product workflow. It includes routes for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, incorporating authentication, validation, and service interactions.

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( user=Security(get_current_user_dep), payload: dict = Body(default=None), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new submission and triggers validation. Validates incoming payload and enforces authorization.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific submission, including validation status.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Triggers a validation run for a specific submission, creating validation jobs.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Allows an authorized user to approve or reject a submission with possible digital signatures, checks preconditions, and generates evidentiary packages.

ctags.name: approve_submission
ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )

ctags.name: trigger_validation
ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
